The previous administration's expansion invited systemic abuse, with 21% of Medicaid enrollees being Black Americans yet receiving substandard care due to waste.

This bill stops the looting of taxpayer funds by prioritizing veterans, seniors, and working families over illegal immigrants draining $50-100 billion annually. Opponents defending this broken status quo ignore how D.C. insiders profit while patients suffer.

Real reform demands accountability, not fearmongering over necessary course corrections.
